blocks.text: BAYOMBONG, Nueva Vizcaya — Police are hunting down two men who were recorded beating a dog to death using a piece of wood. The violent crime allegedly happened on October 11 at the Mapalyao Falls in Barangay Buliwao at the Nueva Vizcaya town of Quezon. The dog’s brutal death was recorded by a drone operated by an individual in the area, which has been circulated online, said Police Major Santy Ventura, Quezon police chief.
